input.question: When was the Zook House built?

documents.text: Jacob Zook House Jacob Zook House, also known as the Rodney House and Store, is a historic home located on the East Lincoln Highway in Exton, West Whiteland Township, Chester County, Pennsylvania. It is a -story, T-shaped, stone dwelling. The house was built about 1820 in the Federal style. It has a "T" kitchen wing added in 1850. It has a one-storey, projecting storefront that replaces the original porch. In 2010, it housed the "Green Papaya" fast food restaurant, however, from 2013, the restaurant it became the "Biryani King" Indian restaurant. It was listed on the National Register of Historic
